DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Discord Developer Portal → your app → **General Information** → Application ID.

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Discord Developer Portal → your app → **General Information** → Public Key.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord Developer Portal → your app → **Bot** → Reset Token.

EVENT_CHANNEL_ID.description: Right-click the event channel in Discord → **Copy Channel ID** (needs Developer Mode).

ALLOWED_ROLE_ID.description: Optional. Right-click the role → **Copy Role ID**. Leave as `-` to skip the extra role check.
